entries.reasoning: The services under Clause 1.1 (port-turnaround analytics and freight demand forecasting in the GCC) match Logistics Analytics Services in the Territory, but whether Cargoline Shipping WLL is a Protected Customer depends on whether it or its Affiliates are listed in Schedule 4 of the Falconridge agreement.
readings: Reading 1: Cargoline Shipping WLL or its Affiliates are listed in Schedule 4 of the Falconridge agreement, bringing the services under the Falconridge non-compete commitment.
Reading 2: Neither Cargoline Shipping WLL nor its Affiliates are listed in Schedule 4, so the Falconridge non-compete restriction does not apply to this agreement.

incomingClauses.quote: 1.1 The Contractor shall provide a Fleet & Port Performance Analytics platform, comprising: (a) ingestion of AIS vessel-tracking data, terminal operating system data from Khalifa Bin Salman Port, and the Client's booking and container-tracking systems; (b) port-turnaround, berth-utilisation and container dwell-time analytics; (c) freight demand forecasting by lane (GCC, Indian subcontinent and East Africa); and (d) executive and operations dashboards.

8.1 The Contractor represents that, as at the date of this Agreement, neither it nor any of its Affiliates is subject to any contractual restriction that would prevent or restrict it from providing the Services to the Client.

entries.suggestedChange: Verify Schedule 4 of the Falconridge MSA with counsel to confirm whether Cargoline Shipping WLL is a Protected Customer, and modify Clause 8.1 to acknowledge existing affiliate commitments.
entries.impact: Potentially collides with the Falconridge non-compete commitment (live through September 2029) if Cargoline is a Protected Customer, making the representation in Clause 8.1 untrue.
